Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Ami Neta Hobo came out first," which contradicts the gathered data that clearly indicated "Hood Of The Living Dead" was released earlier, in 2005. The mistake stemmed from a misinterpretation of the release dates: "Ami Neta Hobo" was released in 2018 and "Hood Of The Living Dead" was released in 2005. Therefore, "Hood Of The Living Dead" came out first. The error manifests as a classic case of chronological misinterpretation, similar to Example 2, where a later date (2018) was mistakenly considered earlier than an earlier date (2005).
